name: Saddlebags
_note: H5 (26 Nov 2026): a Saddlery attachment, moved from balance.json mount_attachments (its rules are in that block's _note). It works everywhere and fits every mount; the mount wears one at a time. price: learning it (level 1); upgrades: levels 2-5 in order, never above the Saddlery's level, and one with needs_burrows only once the Burrows are open (a gate, never a payment). model: the file fitted to each mount's saddle bone, {mount} being the mount look's id (Data.gear_model).
